item.coloph: de ltar bka'i gdams pa 'di/ dkar chag yi ger btab pa yang / rig rje la mthol lo bshags/ 'di bris dge ba'i bsod nams kyis/ bdag sogs phyi rab (rabs) gang zag rnams/ rdzogs pa chen po mthar thug don/ skad cig nyid la rtogs 'gyur nas/ 'khor 'das dbyer med ye rdzogs shog kha ba can gyi bod yul du/ bstan pa bon gyi rgyal mtshan tshug nub pa med pa'i bkra shis shog/
